markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (47%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Simulated frozen section has severe blur (reliability 30%) [F6], and InSitu (47%) nearly ties Invasive (46%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 47%, Invasive 46%, Benign 5%, Normal 2% | Near tie: InSitu vs Invasive |
| Conformal set | {InSitu, Invasive} (alpha 10%, test coverage 90%) | Cannot separate InSitu from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD, blur 3 | Suspect blurred out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (models disagree on top class) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu (20%) [F5]; top Benign (72%) | Weak reference-set consensus for InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 5) · context · Below-typical score (contribution +0.64); descriptive only, AI check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (contribution -0.50) pushes against invasion, AI check 19/20 [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (contribution -0.22) pushes against invasion, AI check 12/20 [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Negative contribution (-0.20), but unreliable with 0/20 AI check · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Positive contribution (+0.18), but unreliable with 0/20 AI check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random (diff +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) on this simulated frozen section masks stromal invasion, given the 46% Invasive probability.
- Out-of-distribution quality distorts embeddings; 4 of 5 nearest reference cases are non-InSitu (top match Benign, 72%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 3, 2**: Inspect highest-risk regions (76%, 56%, 52% risk) to exclude invasive carcinoma.
2. **Region 10**: Check for stromal invasion where the validated invasion concept peaks (risk 47%).
3. **Regions 0, 8**: Verify duct confinement; consider drafted recut/deeper levels and defer frozen margins [F7].
